message:
This PR updates the uv workflow schedule from running daily to running on Monday and Thursday at 13:00 UTC.

## Changes Made

- Updated the cron expression in `.github/workflows/uv.yml` from `"0 13 * * *"` (daily) to `"0 13 * * 1,4"` (Monday and Thursday)
- Updated the corresponding comment to reflect the new schedule

## Background

The uv workflow was previously running daily at 13:00 UTC, which may have been more frequent than necessary. By changing it to run twice a week on specific days, we reduce the frequency while still maintaining regular dependency updates and checks.

## Cron Expression Details

The new cron expression `"0 13 * * 1,4"` means:
- `0` - at minute 0 (start of the hour)
- `13` - at hour 13 (1:00 PM UTC)
- `*` - any day of the month
- `*` - any month
- `1,4` - Monday (1) and Thursday (4)

This change maintains the same execution time (13:00 UTC) but changes the frequency from daily to twice a week on Monday and Thursday.
